cues.heading: Prepare your chair
cues.text: Sit towards the front of a firm, stable chair. Place both feet flat.

cues.heading: Lean, then rise
cues.text: Lean forwards from your hips, then push through your feet to stand.

cues.heading: Find your balance
cues.text: Stand tall and steady. Use the armrests if you need support.

cues.heading: Sit down slowly
cues.text: Move your bottom back and lower slowly onto the chair.

cues.heading: Control the landing
cues.text: Keep your knees aligned with your toes. Avoid dropping into the seat.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use the chair height and number of repetitions your physiotherapist recommends.
